attribution: Source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
description: FRED free fredgraph CSV: daily economic series (VIXCLS, VXNCLS, VXTYN, DGS10, BAA10Y, CPIAUCSL). No API key.
permission_basis: Public economic data published by the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, free to use with attribution; the fredgraph.csv endpoint requires no API key. Used for research only; raw payloads are not redistributed. FRED terms of use reviewed 2026-11-18. This registry entry is an explicit research-use assertion, not a legal determination.
provider: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
timestamp_basis: Daily closing values dated observation_date; the event time is the US equity close (16:00 ET) recorded as 21:00 UTC (fixed; DST is not modelled). The adapter records available_at equal to the event time; the study models the publication lag explicitly in the panel construction (BAA10Y: 2 trading days; VXN: 1 trading day — see the preregistration and manifest).
